OVERVIEW

Hello there, intrepid player!  This leather casting gauntlet is a Mage's Gauntlet item.  These gauntlets allow you to use magical items such as wands, ayanad crystals, and crystals to power unique abilities.
UNLOCKS
Tier 1 - OTS.  PUSH the gauntlet to absorb white, black, and blue crystals, storing up to 5 charges per tier.
- TURN: select a crystal type.

- COVER: consume 1 charge of each crystal to darken a room for 5 minutes.

- RAISE: Consumes 100 energy to summon a void that attempts to draw up to 5 creatures towards it, causing impact damage and disorienting them.  3 minute cooldown.

Analysis of an octagonal ebonwood shadow box indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The Spidersilk Apothecary

Found in Naidem, the box is an octagonal contraption that provides customizations to specific items based on the spiders it has stored inside of it.  These spiders perform their magic best when a web is at the heart of the box.  These special spiders can be found by searching through a web in Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim (eastern side).
How the Apothecary Works
PUT     - a spider (or up to 80 different ones) into the apothecary
GAZE    - to view all of the alteration spiders stored inside by type {ie: wood, stone, etc.}
GLANCE  - to view all of the transmorphing spiders stored inside
LOOK    - to see the status of the apothecary
PEER    - to display a full list of all spiders stored in the apothecary
PINCH   - to create a web inside the apothecary
PLUCK   - to remove the spider that is on display
TICKLE  - to cause the stored item inside to be transformed by a spider
TURN    - to 1, 2, or 3 in order to cycle through alteration designs (alteration spiders only)
TWIST   - to add an item that you want the spiders to modify
WHISPER - cycle through the spiders and/or prepare a spider for removal
It can house 80 unique spiders in total.  Currently:  0 of 80.
BREAK - Destroy the apothecary
PROD - Make the apothecary unable to be destroyed
CHARGES - the apothecary is charged by the web spell.  You can either cast it at the box or wave a wand at it to add charges.  It currently has 0 out of 100 charges stored inside.
Alterations
The box cannot be altered in any way, but the spiders can.  Please pay special attention to them.
The shadow box will cost 10,000,000 coins.
